findings.title: Dev seeding is broken by the Bun switch and the reset still exits 0
findings.evidence: raw/baseline-database-reset-2-missing-yarn-assets.txt shows ENOENT for dist/assets/.../seed-dependencies/yarn.lock and a final exit of 0. Commit 1bf3ec682f deleted three yarn asset files (4272 lines) that runtime code still reads: get-default-application-package-fields.util.ts line 25 reads seed-dependencies/yarn.lock, and application.service.ts calls it. The other two files are consumed indirectly by yarn engine and common-layer copy code; their breakage at logic-function build time is inferred, not observed. A row count taken at the time showed 0 workspaces and 0 users after the failed seed; that query output was not retained.
findings.workaround: restored the three files from a431f9a into the ignored dist/assets only (reproduce.sh restore_baseline_yarn_assets)
findings.smallestFollowUp: Restore or replace the three assets and make the seed command fail loudly.

findings.evidence: raw/baseline-database-reset-1-missing-google-auth-library.txt shows MODULE_NOT_FOUND from google-messaging-notification.handler.js, loaded through dist/command/command.js. findings.class: observed; that yarn hoisting hid it at the baseline is inferred
findings.workaround: NODE_PATH pointing at the store copy (reproduce.sh google_auth_library_path)
